title: Knee pain and other running injuries
claims: NHS advises buying proper running shoes and getting fitted at a running shop, while noting that expensive shoes are not essential.
Unsupportive or worn-out shoes are listed among factors that can contribute to heel pain.

Do not run if you are in pain; for knee pain, severe pain or swelling means seeing a GP straight away, and for shin pain, severe pain, swelling or no improvement after a few weeks means seeing a GP or physiotherapist.

verification.note: 正文全文可读；页面未见 last reviewed 日期。claim 2 把分伤种建议合并为统一规则，判 partial。

claimVerification.note: 原文：“buy the correct running shoes, and it's best to go to a running shop to get fitted. But you do not have to spend a lot of money.”
原文 heel pain 可因“your shoes are not supportive enough or are worn out”，与 sudden increase in running、run uphill 并列。
页面按伤种给阈值：膝“severe or swollen, see a GP straight away”；胫“swollen, severe or does not improve in a few weeks, see a GP or physiotherapist”。删除统一三条件。
